body.en: Type in the Papers panel's search box to search the full text of the project's papers: results are ranked by relevance, each paper shows its matching lines with the words highlighted, and clicking a line opens the paper at that line. Chinese is supported, and the agent searches the same index.
body.zh: 在论文库面板的搜索框中输入，即可检索项目中论文的全文：结果按相关度排序，每篇论文列出匹配的行并高亮关键词，点击某一行即可在该行打开论文。支持中文，AI 助手也使用同一索引进行检索。

title.en: Open Slide works with the Agent panel
title.zh: Open Slide 与 Agent 面板协同

body.en: A presentation shows when the Lattice agent is editing the deck, and Open Slide's Apply comments, Draft a deck and Ask AI now open in the Agent panel.
body.zh: Lattice 智能体编辑演示文稿时，演示文稿会显示提示；Open Slide 的“应用批注”“起草演示文稿”和“询问 AI”现在会在 Agent 面板中打开。

title.en: See what the agent is doing
title.zh: 查看智能体正在做什么

body.en: The Agent panel shows what the current turn is working on.
body.zh: Agent 面板会显示当前回合正在进行的工作。
